children: shares slipped 1% as India's consumer watchdog examines the company's software warranty terms following complaints that the iOS 18 update hurt iPhone functionality and left customers with expensive repair bills.

The review adds another regulatory issue for Apple in India, a market where the company is increasing iPhone production and building its sales presence. The country accounted for 9% of the iPhone market last year, compared with 4% in 2022, Counterpoint Research data shows.

Apple has challenged the allegations. In an August response, the company said software is generally excluded from warranty coverage and maintained that iOS 18 did not create widespread problems. Apple also said customers were informed of the terms before installing the update.
India's regulator moved the matter to a detailed investigation in July. Authorities said consumers were allegedly charged high repair costs for problems linked to the software update.
Potential outcomes could include financial penalties, refunds or changes to Apple's business practices. The company said it remains willing to work with Indian authorities on the case.

title: Apple Stock Slips After India Escalates iPhone Repair Investigation
